entries.title: ExactSDS
entries.description: Cloud software for authoring GHS safety data sheets with AI assistance and built-in translation, covering OSHA, EU CLP, WHMIS and other regimes.

entries.title: ULTRUS SDS Authoring
entries.description: Web-based software for authoring, maintaining and distributing SDS and labels, using the ChemADVISOR regulatory database and multilingual phrase libraries.

entries.title: GoSDS
entries.description: SDS authoring tool from Chemwatch, offered alongside its chemicals management and SDS platform.

entries.title: ExESS
entries.description: Software for authoring safety data sheets, labels and safety instruction cards, usable on workstations, corporate networks or via the cloud.

entries.title: TotalSDS (SDS Author)
entries.description: Cloud platform for SDS management and SDS authoring, with SDS and label creation for multiple countries and languages and an SDS translation service.

entries.title: Chemius
entries.description: Cloud platform for creating EU CLP safety data sheets, technical data sheets and labels, with UFI/PCN management and an AI SDS assistant.

entries.title: SBLCore
entries.description: Software for creating safety data sheets and labels with automated classification and translation, plus UFI generation and PCN submission.

entries.title: ERA SDS Authoring on Demand
entries.description: Online software for authoring safety data sheets and labels, with a blend builder, built-in regulatory lists and automation of all 16 SDS sections.

entries.title: NextSDS
entries.description: Cloud platform for AI-assisted SDS parsing, validation and chemical inventory management, with compliance screening and CLP label generation.

entries.title: HazMix
entries.description: Online application for producing and classifying multilingual safety data sheets, with rule-based supply and transport classification and token-based pricing.

entries.title: GHSClassify
entries.description: Rules-based web application that classifies chemical compounds and mixtures under EU CLP, US OSHA HazCom 2012 and several other GHS implementations.

entries.title: GHS Mixture Calculator
entries.description: Web calculator that classifies mixtures under EU CLP and US OSHA/GHS and generates labels; methods follow 2009 ECHA guidance and GHS Rev. 3.
entries.reason: The site did not load when we checked on 10 October 2026: its domain, ghsmixtures.com, no longer resolves. It will be checked again.

entries.title: GHSAuth (Mar-Kov)
entries.description: SDS and label authoring software
entries.reason: The product site did not load when we checked; only its terms of service did. It will be checked again.

entries.title: ALMEGO
entries.description: SaaS software for authoring safety data sheets for up to 80 markets, with automated translation, UFI generation and direct PCN submission.

entries.title: MySDS
entries.description: Canadian SDS management provider that also offers SDS authoring software and authoring services, powered by Quantum SDS, for WHMIS, OSHA and REACH.

entries.title: Sphera Intelligent Authoring
entries.description: Cloud software on the SpheraCloud platform for authoring SDS and labels, using Sphera's managed regulatory content and authoring rules.

entries.title: KNOX SDS Authoring
entries.description: Named as SDS authoring software in third-party “best of” lists
entries.reason: No SDS product of that name was found; the only company of that name we found works in a different field.

entries.title: CSDS (ChemSafetyPro)
entries.description: Named as SDS authoring software in third-party “best of” lists
entries.reason: ChemSafetyPro.com offers no SDS authoring tool; its tools page is a placeholder.

entries.title: Hazox SDS & Label Authoring
entries.description: SDS and label authoring software with compliance services, including classification, SDS/label audits, re-authoring and country-specific adaptation.
entries.reason: The site has not been updated since 2020 (newest blog post March 2020), so we cannot confirm the service is still offered. It will be checked again.

entries.title: SDSpro
entries.description: SDS management and chemical inventory software in standalone, intranet, client/server and cloud-hosted editions, with right-to-know labels.

entries.title: GisChem mixture calculator
entries.description: Online calculator in the GisChem system that determines CLP classification and labelling of mixtures and prints in-house and DGUV lab labels; in German.

entries.title: NITE-Gmiccs
entries.description: Free Japanese government web system for GHS classification of mixtures and creation of labels and SDS, following GHS Rev. 6/9 and JIS Z 7252/7253.

entries.title: mixclass.net
entries.description: Online calculator for CLP classification of mixtures for health and environmental hazards, with demo calculators and worked examples; physical hazards excluded.

entries.title: SDS Manager
entries.description: Cloud software for managing a company's SDS library and chemical inventory, with QR-code SDS access and mobile apps; vendor also sells SDS authoring and distribution.

entries.title: VelocityEHS SDS Management
entries.description: Cloud SDS management with a searchable SDS database, eBinders and online/offline mobile access for workers, part of the VelocityEHS Accelerate EHS platform.

entries.title: Chemwatch SDS Management
entries.description: Chemical safety platform offering SDS management with access to a vendor SDS collection that the vendor says is updated daily.

entries.title: Mitti by SafetyCulture
entries.description: Workplace operations app for inspections, issues and training that includes a feature for creating and organising electronic safety data sheets.

entries.title: SDSentry
entries.description: Web app for US workplaces that keeps safety data sheets, labels and documented HazCom training records in one system of record for OSHA Hazard Communication.

entries.title: EcoOnline Chemical Manager
entries.description: Cloud chemical management software for SDS libraries, chemical inventories, exposure risk and compliance documents across sites, part of an EHS suite.

entries.title: Intelex SDS Library
entries.description: EHSQ software platform whose health and safety application catalogue lists an SDS Library application alongside incident, audit and training modules.
entries.reason: The product page no longer describes an SDS library: it now shows Intelex quality and supplier applications. It will be checked again.

entries.title: Cority Chemical Management
entries.description: EHS software module that centralises SDS records with version control and tracks chemical inventory, with mobile SDS access for field teams via myCority.

entries.title: HSI Donesafe SDS & Chemical Management
entries.description: Module of the HSI Donesafe EHS platform for managing SDSs and chemicals with QR-code access, risk assessments, approvals and automated revision control.

entries.title: SiteHawk
entries.description: Cloud SDS management software with SDS search, view and print, plus professional services for long-term chemical compliance.

entries.title: StreamTECH SDS Manager
entries.description: Safety and compliance platform whose SDS manager stores SDSs in one place, includes TDG information, handles SDS requests and runs on web and mobile apps.

entries.title: CODESOFT
entries.description: Windows label design software that, per the vendor's GHS page, designs labels with signal words, pictograms and hazard statements and pulls data from SDS.

entries.title: TEKLYNX CENTRAL
entries.description: Centralised label management system with browser access that, per the vendor, pulls symbols, signal words and hazard elements from a central database for GHS labels.

entries.title: Loftware Cloud
entries.description: Cloud labelling platform for chemical companies covering GHS and EU CLP labels, with SAP ECC/S/4HANA integration and content that adjusts to container size.

entries.title: Brady Workstation GHS Label App
entries.description: Downloadable Windows app for Brady printers that creates GHS labels in various sizes from safety data sheet information entered once.

entries.title: BarTender
entries.description: Label design and automation software with GHS chemical label templates and ERP/regulatory-database data feeds for multilingual, country-specific labels.

entries.title: LABELVIEW (TEKLYNX)
entries.description: Named as GHS label software in third-party “best of” lists
entries.reason: A real, general-purpose label design product, but TEKLYNX’s own GHS page names CODESOFT and TEKLYNX CENTRAL, not LABELVIEW.

entries.title: ZebraDesigner (Zebra)
entries.description: Named as GHS label software in third-party “best of” lists
entries.reason: A general label designer for Zebra printers; we found no GHS content for it on zebra.com.

entries.title: Avery Design & Print GHS labels
entries.description: Free online GHS chemical label templates in Avery Design & Print, plus a subscription GHS Wizard that fills label content from a Chemwatch-powered chemical database.

entries.title: OnlineLabels GHS Label Generator
entries.description: Free web tool that creates workplace GHS labels: pick a chemical from a list or enter your own, choose a label size and download a PDF.

entries.title: Seton GHS labels and tags
entries.description: Catalogue of pre-printed GHS chemical labels, secondary container labels, pictogram sheets and self-laminating tags for workplace hazard communication.

entries.title: LabelCalc
entries.description: Named as GHS label software in third-party “best of” lists
entries.reason: LabelCalc is a nutrition-facts label tool, not a GHS label tool.

entries.title: ECHA C&L Inventory

entries.title: ECHA CHEM

entries.title: CLP Regulation on EUR-Lex

entries.title: PubChem
entries.vendor: NCBI, U.S. National Library of Medicine
entries.description: Free NCBI chemical database searchable by name, molecular formula, structure and other identifiers; also publishes a GHS hazard and precautionary code summary.

entries.title: CAMEO Chemicals

entries.description: NOAA database of response information for hazardous materials, with a reactivity tool that predicts hazards when chemicals are mixed.

entries.title: GESTIS Substance Database

entries.title: eChemPortal
entries.description: OECD internet gateway to information on the properties, hazards and risks of chemicals found in the environment, homes, workplaces and products.

entries.title: Haz-Map

entries.title: ILPI (M)SDS HyperGlossary
entries.description: Online glossary explaining terms found on safety data sheets, with entries on GHS and the US Hazard Communication Standard.

entries.title: Cole-Parmer Chemical Compatibility Database

entries.title: ChemicalSafety free SDS search

entries.title: Sigma-Aldrich SDS search
entries.description: Supplier document search on the Sigma-Aldrich site for safety data sheets and certificates (COA/COO) of its products.

entries.title: Illinois DRS GHS classification guide

entries.title: B-Lands Consulting

entries.title: Normachem
entries.description: Consultancy offering SDS authoring, review and translation under REACH, CLP and Regulation (EU) 2020/878, alongside REACH and CLP consulting.

entries.title: Alchemy Compliance

entries.title: GPC Group
entries.description: SDS authoring service from a chemical regulatory consultancy that also handles CLP/GHS classification and REACH and other chemical registrations.

entries.title: RegSurance
entries.description: Consultancy preparing and reviewing SDS and product labels under EU REACH and CLP, alongside packaging (PPWR/EPR), WEEE and battery compliance.

entries.title: Biorius
entries.description: Regulatory consultancy, mainly for cosmetics, preparing and updating SDS from full formulations, including UFI generation and PCN submission.

entries.title: Hazox SDS authoring service
entries.description: SDS and label authoring by an in-house regulatory team from the customer's current SDS, ingredient list and target country.
entries.reason: The site has not been updated since 2020 (newest blog post March 2020), so we cannot confirm the service is still offered. It will be checked again.

entries.title: UL ChemADVISOR for SAP

entries.title: 3E Authoring Services

entries.title: KFT Chemieservice

entries.title: Chemical Watch News & Insight

entries.title: ECHA webinars

entries.title: OSHA Hazard Communication

entries.title: Oxford Chemistry MSDS site (msds.chem.ox.ac.uk)
entries.description: Former University of Oxford chemistry safety-data (MSDS) site; the hostname no longer resolves and no retirement notice was found.

The software also supports data integration from Excel and databases and works with all Windows-supported printers.

entries.description: Online software that keeps safety data sheets in a central searchable library with version history and expiry alerts, linked to the chemical inventory and COSHH assessments.

entries.title: H2 Compliance
entries.description: Irish chemical compliance consultancy that writes, reviews and updates SDSs and GHS labels for OSHA HazCom, WHMIS, REACH and CLP and other markets, with tracking of regulatory changes.

entries.title: mSDS Source
entries.description: Cloud SDS management software, also offered as a full service, with iOS and Android apps, QR-code access and chemical inventory tracking for OSHA HazCom and WHMIS.

entries.title: REGARTIS
entries.description: Czech regulatory consultancy that compiles safety data sheets in all EU languages and for the USA, helps with Turkish and Japanese SDSs, and takes over and updates SDS portfolios.

entries.title: SDS Create
entries.description: Polish consultancy that prepares and updates safety data sheets under REACH and CLP in all EU languages and for markets such as China and Japan, with SDS translation, labels and PCN.

entries.title: EKOS
entries.description: Gdańsk consultancy that prepares, updates and verifies safety data sheets under REACH and CLP, adapts suppliers’ SDSs to Polish law and translates SDSs into the official EU languages.

entries.title: Connect 4 Compliance
entries.description: Manchester regulatory consultancy that writes and updates safety data sheets and performs CLP and GHS classification for UK and EU markets, including multilingual SDSs.

entries.title: Eurideas
entries.description: Translation agency that translates complete SDSs and eSDSs, exposure scenarios, hazard statements and SDS-related label and packaging text for chemicals sold in the EU.

entries.title: Business Team Translations
entries.description: Translation of safety data sheets and legacy MSDSs into 20+ languages, covering 16-section CLP-format SDSs, H and P statements and GHS documentation.

entries.title: AgroLingua
entries.description: Translation agency whose native-speaker technical translators, living in the target country, translate safety data sheets, with every translation checked by a second translator.

entries.title: ILS Translations
entries.description: Translation of existing SDSs and MSDSs into about 40 languages, with second-linguist review, SDS formatting checks and human post-editing of AI-generated SDS content.

entries.title: AidPro
entries.description: Polish consultancy in Zabrze that writes, verifies, updates and translates safety data sheets for chemical products under REACH and CLP, with PCN and SCIP support.

entries.title: SDS-FullService
entries.description: Cloud platform and managed service that indexes and checks supplier safety data sheets, requests missing or updated SDSs from suppliers and builds the chemical inventory.

entries.title: Bizzmine SDS Management
entries.description: Module of the Bizzmine EHS platform that keeps a central register of substances and SDS files, tracks expiring SDSs and gives QR-code access on the work floor.

entries.title: Chemeter
entries.description: Software that generates safety data sheets from a product formula, classifying mixtures under CLP and GHS rules, with label, UFI/PCN and transport-document modules.

entries.title: SDS Xperts
entries.description: Portuguese consultancy that prepares safety data sheets in several languages to the legislation of the target country, manages REACH and CLP compliance and notifies the Portuguese poison centre (CIAV).
entries.reason: The site names no company, address or registration number, so we cannot say who offers the service. It will be checked again.

entries.title: SDS Manager Free SDS Search
entries.description: Free web search of SDS Manager’s database of more than 17 million safety data sheets, with a region filter and free PDF download; no account needed.

entries.title: SYSPRO
entries.description: Appears in Google ads for “GHS and MSDS management”
entries.reason: An ERP for manufacturers: its chemical-industry page only says the platform can attach MSDSs to products and help meet GHS. We found no page for an SDS or GHS module with facts to list.

entries.title: Quick-FDS
entries.description: Appears in search results for “SDS management” in France
entries.reason: Acquired by 3E in 2024: its product pages now redirect to 3E, which is listed in this directory, and its own site shows no text without JavaScript.

entries.title: UK Chemical Suppliers
entries.description: Appears in search results for “SDS authoring UK”
entries.reason: A directory of chemical suppliers: its SDS authoring page lists other companies’ services; it offers no SDS service of its own.

entries.title: BPO Master
entries.description: Appears in search results for “(M)SDS services”
entries.reason: A back-office data-processing company: its SDS offer is scanning, indexing and data entry, not SDS authoring or an SDS management system.

entries.title: SAP S/4HANA for product compliance
entries.description: SAP S/4HANA module that checks products against compliance requirements, manages compliance documents per product and country, sends safety data sheets automatically and handles dangerous goods.

entries.title: GUS.hsm powered by dibac
entries.description: Hazardous-substance management software from dibac that classifies mixtures under CLP, generates SDSs in multiple languages, and manages UFI codes, PCN notifications and dangerous-goods data.

entries.title: egsidaX
entries.description: Software to create, manage and print safety data sheets under REACH and the German Hazardous Substances Ordinance in EU official languages, with add-on modules for registers, instructions and labelling.

entries.title: envis
entries.description: Modular environmental, energy and hazardous-substance management software that keeps a hazardous-substance register and creates safety data sheets in up to 30 languages and container labels.

entries.title: eposChemAI
entries.description: Software for creating and managing safety data sheets and labels, with GHS classification, an AI copilot, PCN module and hazardous-substance register; available as cloud SaaS, on-premises or desktop.

entries.title: SAFIN.NET
entries.vendor: I+K AG für Information und Know-how
entries.description: Web application for CLP and GHS classification and labelling, safety data sheet authoring and on-demand GHS label printing, with interfaces to external programs such as SAP.

entries.title: Prosisoft HSM NAV
entries.vendor: Trace one GmbH, Gesellschaft für Umweltmanagementsysteme
entries.description: Hazardous-substance module for Microsoft Dynamics NAV that classifies substances and dangerous goods from production recipes, dispatches SDSs on order posting and generates labels and transport documents.

entries.title: e-SDB (eska)
entries.description: Web-based tool for creating REACH safety data sheets with EuPhraC standard phrases, translation into 31 languages and output as PDF with embedded SDScomXML data.

entries.title: Ecobio Manager
entries.description: Chemical management module of the Ecobio Manager service that provides up-to-date safety data sheets, chemical inventory lists, labels and safety cards, and identifies restricted substances.

entries.title: SdSArea
entries.description: Software that automatically sends a company's safety data sheets to its customers, notifies them when an SDS is modified and records whether they downloaded it.

entries.title: HELACLOUD SDS
entries.description: Cloud application hosted in Germany that uses AI to extract data from supplier safety data sheets, runs formal and compliance checks, and updates SAP or other ERP systems.

entries.title: TÜV Rheinland go>safe
entries.vendor: AMD TÜV Arbeitsmedizinische Dienste GmbH (TÜV Rheinland)
entries.description: go>safe is an online hazardous-substance management system with a central substance register, regular SDS updates and a basis for risk assessments and operating instructions.

entries.title: sigma X (eska)
entries.description: Hazardous-substance management software for recording and risk-assessing substances, creating operating instructions and labels, managing safety data sheets and building the hazardous-substance register.

entries.title: GMS hazardous substance management (eska)
entries.description: Managed hazardous-substance management service: eska records substances on site, procures, checks and updates safety data sheets, maintains the hazardous-substance register and prints labels.

entries.title: Chemical Check
entries.description: SDS authoring service producing safety data sheets for all EU and EEA countries in their official languages, with native-speaker translation, raw-material data checks and a daily update service.

entries.title: UMCO
entries.description: Hamburg consultancy that writes safety data sheets for substances and mixtures for EU and non-EU jurisdictions, including extended SDSs with REACH exposure scenarios and per-product label reports.

entries.title: IFZ Berlin
entries.description: Berlin consultancy service that prepares GHS-compliant safety data sheets in more than 50 languages for regions including Europe, North America, China and Russia.

entries.title: REACH & REACHER
entries.vendor: REACH & REACHER Consulting und Verlag GmbH
entries.description: Consultancy service that creates SDSs in all EU official languages with classification calculations, eSDS exposure-scenario annexes, label texts, PSDS for non-hazardous products, and non-EU SDSs.

entries.title: ADEEGO
entries.description: Consultancy service preparing safety data sheets in all European languages, for the USA and Canada, and for China via a local partner, plus translation of its own SDSs.

entries.title: HSE DATA
entries.description: Service that prepares safety data sheets for chemical products under CLP and REACH for more than 25 countries, with a 2-year update service included.

entries.title: SafetyDocs
entries.description: Dutch service that drafts safety data sheets and the corresponding label information for chemical substances and mixtures that companies supply to their customers.

entries.title: eska
entries.description: Service for creating, updating and translating safety data sheets, and for checking whether a client's existing safety data sheets meet current regulations.

entries.title: epos Software & Service
entries.description: Service in which epos experts author new SDSs from customer recipes, update and review existing ones, and produce translated country versions in over 50 languages for 14 jurisdictions.

entries.title: NOVA Aftersales
entries.description: Overath company whose EHS services write safety data sheets in 40 language combinations, prepare hazard communication labels and file poison centre notifications.

entries.title: REACh ChemConsult
entries.description: Dresden consultancy that prepares safety data sheets under REACH and CLP for all EU and EEA countries and for countries such as China, USA, Canada, Japan and Brazil.

entries.title: ACA-pharma concept
entries.description: Regulatory consultancy service for chemical substances and mixtures covering CLP classification and labelling, poison centre (PCN) and SCIP notifications, and REACH registration dossiers.

entries.title: Umweltkanzlei
entries.description: Consultancy service offering CLP classification of mixtures, safety data sheets for the EU and selected markets worldwide, label elements, UFI codes, PCN notifications and an external hazardous-substances officer.

entries.title: BfU Dr. Poppe AG
entries.vendor: Betreuungsgesellschaft für Umweltfragen Dr. Poppe AG
entries.description: Consultancy service that creates SDSs for substances and mixtures, reviews existing SDSs for completeness and classification, and prepares extended SDSs including exposure scenarios.

entries.title: Gefahrgutberatung Florian Herber
entries.description: Dangerous-goods consultancy offering CLP-compliant safety data sheets with regular updates in several EU languages, plus UFI codes, PCN notifications and an external hazardous-substances officer.

entries.title: DLAC
entries.description: Consultancy service preparing and reviewing safety data sheets and extended SDSs under REACH and CLP, translating them into 22 EU languages, and creating CLP product labels.

entries.title: Chemical Compliance (Petra Laacks)
entries.description: Chemical regulatory consultancy that prepares safety data sheets, carries out registrations and notifications, reviews the worldwide legal status of products, and conducts compliance audits.

entries.title: asseso
entries.description: Service that prepares and updates safety data sheets from customer product data for EU and non-EU distribution countries, including country-specific emergency numbers.

entries.title: ENVISAFE
entries.description: Heidelberg consultancy offering classification of preparations, SDS authoring in all EU languages, SDS review, UFI/ECHA notification, operating instructions and external REACH officer services.

entries.title: TÜV SÜD
entries.description: TÜV SÜD Industrie Service offers GHS/CLP compliance services: classification of substances and mixtures, safety data sheets in all EU languages, poison centre and C&L inventory notifications.

entries.title: CFCS-Consult
entries.description: CFCS-Consult supports preparation and submission of EU poison centre notifications: checking the notification obligation, preparing the IUCLID dossier and managing submission through the authority portal.

entries.title: Renfrey Regulatory & Compliance Consultancy
entries.description: UK and Irish regulatory consultancy offering GHS/EU CLP/GB CLP classification, SDS preparation and review, label checks, poison centre notifications/UFI, UK REACH support, translation and training.

entries.title: Strober & Partner
entries.description: Hazardous-substances service that reviews or prepares safety data sheets, classifies and labels products and waste, and supports REACH and Gefahrstoffverordnung obligations and staff instruction.

entries.title: PRYMEC
entries.description: Swiss consultancy that classifies chemical inventories, writes and reviews safety data sheets, advises on REACH, CLP, SCIP and PCN compliance, and implements SAP regulatory content.

entries.title: invitro-connect
entries.vendor: ITLS in vitro – Testing Laboratory Services LLC
entries.description: Creates, updates and checks REACH safety data sheets for Germany and many other countries, prepares extended SDSs, and classifies substances under EU CLP and Asian GHS.

entries.title: HELASOFT
entries.description: Consulting services covering SDS preparation and compliance checks in customer systems, CLP/GHS classification and labelling, PCN and SCIP notifications, REACH registration management and SAP dangerous goods configuration.

entries.title: Atrion Intelligent Authoring
entries.description: Named on the German BAuA list of SDS software (January 2026)
entries.reason: IHS bought Atrion in 2010; its Intelligent Authoring software is now Sphera Intelligent Authoring, which is listed in this directory. atrionintl.com no longer has a site of its own.

entries.title: Infor PLM for Process (Optiva)
entries.description: Named on the German BAuA list of SDS software (January 2026)
entries.reason: A formulation PLM for process manufacturers. Its product page names no SDS, GHS or hazard labelling; safety data sheets appear once, in a list on a brochure page.

entries.title: iPoint Compliance
entries.description: Named on the German BAuA list of SDS software (January 2026)
entries.reason: Product-compliance software for REACH, RoHS, SCIP and PFAS reporting in the supply chain, now part of Assent. No page covers writing or managing SDSs or GHS/CLP classification.

entries.title: SDB-Writer
entries.description: Named on the German BAuA list of SDS software (January 2026)
entries.reason: Only the home page of toxolution.de loads. The SDB-Writer product page, the contact page and the legal notice return 404 (checked 11 October 2026).

entries.title: halbach-consulting
entries.description: Named on the German BAuA list of SDS consultants (September 2026)
entries.reason: The SDS page still describes the move from the Preparations Directive to CLP in 2015 and nothing later; we found no sign the service is current.

entries.title: REACHECK-OR
entries.description: Only Representative service provider for non-EU manufacturers exporting into the EU under REACH, covering registration dossiers, SIEF representation and C&L Inventory notification.

entries.title: Reach Integra
entries.description: Spain-based chemical regulatory services company of the INERCO Group offering an Only Representative service for non-European companies, substance registration, biocides regulation, consortia management, classification and labelling, and training.

entries.title: REACHLINKED
entries.description: Compliance service provider with a UK company and an Estonian company, offering Only Representative and registration services, technical support and consulting for EU REACH, UK REACH, China REACH, Korea K-REACH and Turkey KKDIK.
entries.reason: The site has not been updated for years: it still presents the 2021 deadlines as upcoming, so we cannot confirm the service is still offered. It will be checked again.

entries.title: CRAD
entries.vendor: CRAD ÇEVRE RİSK ANALİZ DENETİM VE EĞİTİM HİZMETLERİ A.Ş.
entries.description: Istanbul-based regulatory compliance company offering a KKDIK Only Representative service for manufacturers outside Turkey, plus EU REACH, EU Poison Center notification and UFI, CLP and SDS compliance services.

entries.title: REACHLaw
entries.description: Finland-headquartered chemical regulatory compliance provider offering Only Representative services under EU, UK, Turkish, Korean and Ukrainian REACH, registration support, and EU poison centre notification.

entries.title: REACH Global Services
entries.description: Regulatory consultancy headquartered in Brussels offering Only Representative, REACH registration dossier preparation, SIEF and consortium management for EU REACH, plus Turkish KKDIK registration and representation and Ukraine REACH services.

entries.title: EPY
entries.description: EPY is a modular software suite for authoring, managing and distributing safety data sheets and hazard labels from product formulations, with CLP classification and UFI/PCN notification modules. The vendor states that labels and SDS are available in 37 languages.

entries.title: Geowin SDS
entries.description: Geowin SDS is software for drafting and managing safety data sheets, offered as a Windows client/server installation or as a browser-based cloud version. Modules cover CLP classification, labels, UFI calculation and PCN dossiers with bulk System-to-System submission to ECHA, and emailing SDS to customers.

entries.title: SDS OnDemand
entries.description: SDS OnDemand is a web platform by Image Line through which manufacturers of agrochemicals, fertilisers, biocides and other professional-use hazardous products make safety data sheets, labels and mandatory communications available to distributors and users. Distributors use the service free of charge.

entries.title: REACHUP
entries.vendor: REACHUP REGULATORY NETWORK ITALY - RNI SRL
entries.description: REACHUP Regulatory Network Italy (RNI) is a Milan-based regulatory consultancy that acts as REACH Only Representative for non-EU companies and prepares registration dossiers, SDS and extended SDS, and CLP classification. Its site also lists Only Representative services for the UK and Turkey and support for biocides and cosmetics.

entries.title: Pro-Eko
entries.description: Pro-Eko is a chemical manufacturer in Petacciato (Molise) that also drafts and updates safety data sheets under REACH, CLP and Regulation (EU) 2020/878 and supports UFI creation, PCN dossiers and cosmetic PIF/CPNP. It publishes prices in its online shop, starting at EUR 75 for an SDS.

entries.title: Flashpoint
entries.description: Flashpoint is a consultancy based in Cascina (Pisa) on dangerous goods and product safety that drafts safety data sheets, either fully outsourced or supporting in-house staff, along with exposure scenarios and PCN and SCIP notifications. It drafts SDS in all EU languages and for non-EU countries on request; its sister company Flashpoint Learning runs CLP and SDS courses.

entries.title: CEPRA
entries.description: CEPRA is a consulting and testing company in Casalecchio di Reno (Bologna) that drafts and updates safety data sheets and extended SDS under REACH with CLP/GHS classification, translates SDS into EU and non-EU languages, and prepares SDS for major non-EU markets. It also acts as REACH Only Representative for non-EU companies.

entries.title: Chemicals Consulting
entries.description: Chemicals Consulting (Safe and Sound S.r.l.) classifies substances and mixtures under CLP and under GHS criteria for over 50 non-EU countries, generates UFI codes, prepares PCN and C&L Inventory notifications, and drafts and reviews SDS including exposure scenarios. It also offers CLP and PCN training.

entries.title: Toxicon
entries.description: Toxicon is a Milan-based toxicology and regulatory consultancy that offers on-demand courses on REACH, CLP, safety data sheets and poison centre notifications, held online, at its Pavia, Milan and Turin training sites or at the customer. It also provides toxicological assessments and regulatory compliance consulting, including annual consulting packages.

entries.title: Chemsafe
entries.description: Chemsafe is a regulatory consultancy near Ivrea (Turin) that acts as EU REACH Only Representative and prepares registration dossiers, exposure scenarios and CSA/CSR documents. It also authors SDS to EU and OSHA standards in almost all EU languages, classifies and labels substances and mixtures, and prepares PCN submissions with UFI.

entries.title: Centro Reach
entries.description: Centro Reach is a Milan service company set up in 2007 on the initiative of Federchimica and Assolombarda. It provides REACH and CLP compliance audits, preparation and review of SDS, CLP classification and labelling, poison centre and SCIP notifications, and REACH registration dossiers. It also runs catalogue and on-demand training and supports exports to non-EU countries.

entries.title: CEFIS
entries.description: CEFIS is a dangerous-goods packaging and consulting company in Cormano (Milan). It drafts and reviews SDS in Italian and English, checks the associated hazard labels, handles UFI, CLP Annex VIII and SCIP notifications, and adapts SDS and labels to US GHS requirements.

entries.title: Niuko
entries.vendor: Niuko – Innovation & Knowledge Srl Società Unipersonale
entries.description: Niuko, the training and consulting company of Confindustria Vicenza, runs basic and advanced courses on REACH, CLP and safety data sheets and a CLP Annex VIII / PCN training path. It also consults on REACH registration, exposure scenarios, SDS preparation and CLP classification.

entries.title: Future Tech
entries.description: Future Tech is a Milan-area label-printing specialist that supplies the EPY+.LAB hazard-label software (30 languages, multilingual labels, PDF output) together with thermal-transfer and colour label printers, labels and consumables. It also offers technical support and operating leases.

entries.title: Rubino
entries.description: Rubino is a label-printing supplier in Giffoni Valle Piana (Salerno) offering colour printing systems for in-house, on-demand GHS labels compliant with CLP. It supplies polyester and polypropylene label materials certified to BS 5609, Epson ColorWorks and OKI printers, and resin thermal-transfer ribbons.

entries.title: Aglatech14
entries.description: Aglatech14 is a Milan translation company, certified to ISO 17100 and ISO 18587, that publishes a dedicated page on translating safety data sheets. It describes native-speaker translators, customer glossaries and translation memories, bilingual revision and technical desktop publishing.

entries.title: Studio INTRA
entries.description: Studio INTRA is a translation studio in Udine that has translated safety data sheets for several clients over many years. It handles full translation, additions, new languages and archive management, using computer-assisted translation tools for standard texts.

entries.title: WEAREFORSDS
entries.description: WEAREFORSDS is a cloud module of the WEAREFORCLOUD HSE platform by MADE HSE for managing the chemical products used in a company and their safety data sheets. It records suppliers, substances and H/EUH classification, stores and shares SDS, and screens substances against REACH, SVHC, Annex XIV–XVII, endocrine-disruptor and Proposition 65 lists.

entries.title: Necsi
entries.description: Necsi is a consulting and training company in Romano d'Ezzelino (Vicenza) offering REACH and CLP compliance audits. It also checks SDS for REACH/CLP compliance against reference databases, verifies CLP labelling and screens raw materials for restricted substances and SVHCs.

entries.title: eQgest
entries.description: Software that automates the creation, updating and distribution of safety data sheets, with modules for CLP labels, PCN dossiers with automatic UFI generation, ADR documentation, country GHS adaptations and ERP integration.

entries.title: Emeba Consulting
entries.description: Madrid consultancy for the EU REACH and CLP regulations: preparation and audit of safety data sheets, chemical classification and labelling, poison centre notifications with UFI assignment, SCIP notifications, compliance audits and tailored REACH-CLP training.

entries.title: REACH Plus
entries.description: Bilbao consultancy (a registered brand of Almau Abogados SL) working on REACH registrations and IUCLID dossiers, safety data sheet preparation, updating and translation, CLP classification and labelling, poison centre and SCIP notifications, and REACH and CLP training.

entries.title: Quimi-Reach
entries.description: Barcelona consultancy and training practice run by a chemical engineer: safety data sheet preparation and review, REACH registrations, toxicological notification of hazardous mixtures, ADR safety adviser services and recorded online courses on REACH, CLP, SDS, SCIP and ADR.

entries.title: Tandem HSE
entries.description: Barcelona HSE consultancy and engineering firm whose product safety unit prepares, reviews, updates and translates safety data sheets, classifies and labels substances and mixtures under CLP, prepares REACH registrations, acts as Only Representative and handles SCIP and poison centre notifications.

entries.title: INERCO
entries.description: Seville engineering and consulting group whose chemical product safety service covers REACH registration dossiers, Only Representative for non-EU companies, CLP classification and label design, safety data sheets and extended SDSs, supplier SDS audits, biocides applications and training.

entries.title: ITENE
entries.vendor: ITENE, Instituto Tecnológico del Embalaje, Transporte y Logística
entries.description: Technology institute in Paterna (Valencia) offering chemical-safety consulting and training: preparation, updating and translation of REACH-CLP safety data sheets, hazard classification, CLP label review, poison centre and C&L notifications via ECHA and exposure scenarios for extended SDSs.

entries.title: AbroadLink
entries.description: Madrid translation company offering ISO 17100 translation of safety data sheets, extended SDSs, hazard and precautionary statements and labels, with independent revision by a second linguist for higher-risk safety content.

entries.title: ASECONSA
entries.vendor: ASESORÍA DE CONSUMO Y SANIDAD, S.L.
entries.description: Spanish consumer and health regulatory consultancy (offices in Seville, Madrid and San Roque) that prepares 16-section safety data sheets under REACH in Spanish and English and verifies the CLP classification of each component and of the mixture.

entries.title: INESEM
entries.vendor: Instituto Europeo de Estudios Empresariales S.L.U
entries.description: Online business school in Maracena (Granada) offering a 150-hour, 100% online course on REACH and CLP legislation with a certificate issued by the school.

entries.title: Vivotecnia
entries.description: Madrid contract research organisation running GLP toxicology and analytical studies across REACH endpoints, also for CLP classification and biocide registration, with support for dossier preparation and study planning.

entries.title: AIMPLAS
entries.vendor: Asociación de Investigación de Materiales Plásticos y Conexas (AIMPLAS)
entries.description: Plastics technology centre in Paterna (Valencia) advising plastics companies on REACH and CLP compliance, including review and verification of safety data sheets, template letters and certificates for suppliers and customers, regulatory monitoring and legislation training.

entries.title: URJC
entries.description: Public university in Móstoles (Madrid) offering an online continuing-education expert course on the CLP Regulation (classification, labelling and packaging and recent amendments): 30 hours, 3 ECTS.

entries.title: INSST BDLEP
entries.vendor: Instituto Nacional de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (INSST)
entries.description: Free online database of the Spanish national occupational safety institute with the occupational exposure limits for chemical agents in Spain (environmental and biological limit values, toxicological documentation, sampling methods), searchable by CAS number or name; INSST also publishes the INFOCARQUIM database of CMR substances with harmonised CLP classification.

entries.title: RISCTOX
entries.description: Online database of hazardous substances developed by ISTAS (CC.OO. trade union institute), giving CLP classification, health and environmental risks, applicable regulations and lists such as carcinogens, endocrine disruptors and PBT/vPvB substances for individual substances.

entries.title: ATQ
entries.description: Valencia consultancy for detergent, biocide, cosmetic and other chemical manufacturers, preparing and updating safety data sheets, handling sanitary registrations and biocide (BPR) registrations, with an in-house laboratory, dangerous-goods advice and tailored training.

entries.title: THETA Consulting
entries.description: THETA Consulting prepares, updates and translates safety data sheets, handles PCN notifications and UFI codes, prepares REACH registration dossiers in IUCLID 6 and acts as Only Representative. It also runs open, closed and online training on REACH, CLP and SDS.

entries.title: KartaCharakterystyki.com
entries.description: KartaCharakterystyki.com is a browser-based SaaS platform for preparing safety data sheets, classifying mixtures and building CLP labels, with PDF/DOCX export depending on the plan. AI features help organise data and draft content; the vendor states that AI output does not replace chemical or regulatory assessment.

entries.title: Tritone
entries.description: Tritone is a chemical management platform with a safety data sheet register (current and archived), a register of substances and mixtures, a label generator and hazard, CMR, OEL and Seveso reports. SDS authoring in Polish or English and SDS compliance review are offered as paid add-on services.

entries.title: chemIQ
entries.description: chemIQ is a chemical management application in which users build their own register of substances from the safety data sheets in the chemIQ database. It scores mixture hazards with the ORCH algorithm and includes a CLP label creator in four sizes with a QR code linking to the full SDS.

entries.title: Łukasiewicz–IChP
entries.vendor: Sieć Badawcza Łukasiewicz - Instytut Chemii Przemysłowej imienia Profesora Ignacego Mościckiego
entries.description: The Łukasiewicz Industrial Chemistry Institute, a public research institute in Warsaw, prepares, updates and verifies safety data sheets, registers substances under REACH and prepares PCN notifications. It runs online REACH and CLP training on Microsoft Teams.

entries.title: Silk Road Certification
entries.vendor: SILK ROAD CERTIFICATION SP. Z O.O.
entries.description: Silk Road Certification, a certification body and consultancy in Gliwice, prepares EU REACH and UK REACH registration dossiers and acts as Only Representative for Great Britain. It also prepares safety data sheets and exposure scenarios, translates them between Polish and English, and supports UFI notifications.

entries.title: Etisoft
entries.description: Etisoft, a label manufacturer in Gliwice, produces GHS chemical labels to customer specifications, mostly on film, resistant to water, cleaning agents and organic solvents. It also supplies label printers and ETILABEL software for designing and printing CLP/GHS labels.

entries.title: Chemtra
entries.description: Chemtra prepares safety data sheets from formulations or from foreign-language originals, reviews existing SDS for legal compliance, and translates SDS and labels. It also runs training delivered online via Google Meet.

entries.title: J.G.Training
entries.description: J.G.Training runs a one-day course on REACH, CLP and the Polish act on chemical substances, covering safety data sheets under Regulation 2020/878 and CLP amendments. It is held online or in a training room in Warsaw, and closed courses are available on request.

entries.title: Pro-Perfekt
entries.description: Pro-Perfekt prepares, updates, translates and audits safety data sheets, handles mixture notifications and label information under CLP, and supports REACH registration. For cosmetics it prepares safety assessments and CPSR reports and supports PIF and CPNP notifications.

entries.title: Konsiglio
entries.description: Konsiglio prepares, updates and translates safety data sheets, prepares CLP labels and UFI codes, and handles REACH registration and classification and labelling inventory notifications. It also gives ongoing REACH and RoHS support.

entries.title: Karty MSDS
entries.vendor: Drelich & Zielski Concept Sp. z o.o.
entries.description: Karty MSDS prepares safety data sheets for chemical mixtures and cosmetics to current REACH and CLP requirements. It also advises on REACH, CLP and cosmetics registration and registers biocidal products.

entries.title: Polski Ruch Czystszej Produkcji
entries.description: The Polish Cleaner Production association in Katowice runs open online training on safety data sheets under Regulation 2020/878 and on company obligations under REACH and CLP, delivered on ClickMeeting. A separate course on PCN notifications can be ordered.

entries.title: 123Tlumacz.pl
entries.description: A Kraków translation agency that translates safety data sheets into all European languages, and from Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Arabic into Polish. It assigns SDS work only to translators with chemistry training.

entries.title: Ardpol
entries.description: Ardpol sells colour label printers (VIPColor VP700/VP750, Epson ColorWorks C7500 and TM-C3500), including models described as suitable for GHS-compliant drum and chemical labels. It also supplies blank labels in any size on ink-absorbent paper or film.

entries.title: PPUH BART
entries.description: PPUH BART is a label printer in Środa Wielkopolska that prints chemical labels on paper or film by flexography and/or thermal transfer. It recommends film labels resistant to weather, UV, chemicals and solvents.

entries.title: Doradcy 365
entries.description: Doradcy 365, a Wrocław advisory group, sells fixed-price services that generate a UFI code and submit a PCN notification for a hazardous mixture. It also prepares and submits classification and labelling notifications to ECHA's C&L Inventory.

entries.title: iRyzyko
entries.description: iRyzyko is an online occupational risk assessment application. On the Plus plan it reads an uploaded SDS PDF and turns the substance name, H statements, health effects and protective equipment into a chemical hazard; OEL values (NDS/NDSCh) can be added as a separate hazard.

entries.title: de ViB fabriek
entries.description: Dutch service provider that drafts and translates safety data sheets, prepares CLP label content and handles UFI and PCN notifications; it is also a CHEMDOX software partner for the Netherlands and Belgium. Its English-language site is The SDS Factory (thesdsfactory.com).

entries.title: ChemPros
entries.description: Chemical compliance service provider that drafts and translates safety data sheets (including e-SDS with exposure scenarios), prepares CLP labels and workplace instruction cards, and handles UFI/PCN, C&L and cosmetics notifications.

entries.title: Stoffenmanager
entries.description: Web-based software for working safely with hazardous substances: a hazardous-substances and CMR register, qualitative and quantitative risk assessment and workplace instruction cards, sold as a free Basic licence and paid annual licences. It is operated by Cosanta B.V. in Amstelveen.

entries.title: Stoffenjournaal.nl
entries.description: Online tool that builds a PGS 15 hazardous-substances journal and an Arbo substances register from uploaded safety data sheets or Excel imports, with alerts for missing or outdated SDSs, SDS QR cards and workplace instruction cards. It is a product of PGS Solutions in Amsterdam.

entries.title: UFI.eu
entries.description: Almere-based service that creates UFI codes and submits poison centre notifications (PCN) to EU poison centres, and also offers SDS authoring, SDS translation and CLP label services with published prices.

entries.title: Chemleg Europe
entries.description: Chemical regulatory consultancy whose Dutch entity Chemleg Europe B.V. offers Only Representation under EU, UK, Turkish and Ukrainian REACH, registration dossiers, CLP services (UFI, PCN, C&L notification, labels) and SDS/e-SDS authoring; it has offices in the Netherlands and Türkiye.

entries.title: Reach Chemical
entries.description: Rotterdam company that acts as Only Representative for chemical manufacturers outside the EU and prepares IUCLID inquiry and registration dossiers, SDSs and CLP labels, poison centre notifications and SCIP notifications; on request it acts as importer of record.

entries.title: Ecomatters
entries.description: Utrecht sustainability consultancy founded in 2008 that advises on REACH, including SVHC screening, exposure scenarios and preparing and submitting REACH registration dossiers.

entries.title: Trade Wind
entries.description: Company in Capelle aan den IJssel that drafts safety data sheets from customer formulation data, translates them into more than 52 languages and distributes them through its DeDoks internet system; it also represents Lisam Systems software in the Netherlands.

entries.title: Businesslabels
entries.description: Webshop of Smart2B B.V. in Wekerom that sells Epson ColorWorks colour label printers and BS5609-certified matte plastic labels for printing CLP/GHS labels in-house, including a GHS labelling starter kit.

entries.title: TPC Advies
entries.description: Dutch chemical product-safety adviser that drafts, updates and translates safety data sheets, prepares CLP label content, handles PCN notifications and UFI codes, gives awareness training and acts as an ADR dangerous-goods safety adviser.

entries.title: Triskelion
entries.description: Utrecht regulatory and toxicology consultancy, founded as a TNO spin-off, that prepares and submits REACH registration dossiers including IUCLID files, data-gap analysis and hazard, exposure and risk assessment.

entries.title: REACH Product Safety
entries.description: Dordrecht consultancy on legal obligations for chemical products that handles REACH registrations, compliance checks, safety data sheets, consultancy and training.

entries.title: Chemrade
entries.description: Nijmegen web-based software for registering hazardous substances and assessing their workplace risks with validated exposure models (Advanced REACH Tool, Stoffenmanager, ECETOC TRA), with workplace instruction cards drawn from SDS hazard information.

entries.title: Cross Approach
entries.description: Apeldoorn QHSE software whose hazardous-substances module keeps a central online substance register with safety data sheets, generates workplace instruction cards per substance and includes a risk-analysis module.

entries.title: De Koningh
entries.description: Duiven supplier of coding and labelling equipment for GHS labels: desktop and print-and-apply printers, a SwiftColor colour printer, a two-colour inkjet case printer, NiceLabel GHS software with phrases in 20 languages, and BS5609 labels.

entries.title: Rebo
entries.description: Soest supplier of industrial label printers and consumables since 1976 that offers a GHS label programme built with NiceLabel, which fills in hazard symbols and H and P phrases in over 20 languages, plus multi-colour label printers and chemical-resistant ribbons.

entries.title: ALTEC
entries.description: Papendrecht supplier of identification products that sells full-colour GHS labels for printing pictograms and H and P phrases on its LASSIE2 Plus label printer, with LASSIE2 software.

entries.title: Vertaalbureau Perfect
entries.description: Enschede translation agency with offices in several Dutch cities and Germany that translates material safety data sheets; it states that all its translators meet ISO 17100.

entries.title: Chemiekaarten Online
entries.description: Dutch reference work on more than 1,400 pure substances giving each substance's safety-relevant properties, risks, and prevention and emergency measures, sold as an online subscription and a yearly book edition by publisher Lefebvre Sdu.

entries.title: ITER TECH REACH consulting and Only Representative
entries.description: ITER TECH S.r.l. is a consulting and training company in Frosinone, founded in 2006, focused on dangerous goods and chemicals regulation. Its REACH page offers the company as Only Representative, registration support, drafting and review of safety data sheets, SVHC and SCIP notifications, and REACH and SDS audits.

entries.title: PQA REACH, CLP and product safety consulting
entries.description: Progetto Qualità e Ambiente (PQA) is a Milan consultancy founded in 1996 that offers health, safety, environmental and product-compliance services. Its REACH/CLP page lists REACH check-ups and consulting, consulting on safety data sheets, advice on SVHC and SCIP notification duties, labelling support and staff training on REACH.

entries.title: CHEMSTUDIO REACH, CLP and SDS consulting
entries.description: CHEMSTUDIO is a regulatory consultancy in Rosà (Vicenza) working on REACH and CLP. Its consulting page lists safety data sheet compilation, PCN notification with UFI, REACH registration and SIEF support, exposure scenarios and SCIP notification, and it arranges laboratory tests through partner laboratories.

entries.title: Lingua Nova chemical and SDS translation
entries.description: Lingua Nova is a Warsaw translation agency opened in 1991 that offers specialist translation in more than 50 languages. Its chemical-industry page lists translation of safety data sheets (SDS/MSDS) and product labels by translators with documented chemistry experience.

entries.title: Etykiety.pl chemical labels
entries.description: Etidruk Etykiety.pl is a label printer in Lubochnia (Łódź region) that makes self-adhesive labels to customer requirements. Its chemical-labels page states that the labels meet CLP/GHS requirements and use materials resistant to moisture, chemicals, abrasion and solvents.

entries.title: Pieńkowski Consulting REACH and CLP advice
entries.description: Pieńkowski Consulting (brand DGSA Support) is a dangerous-goods and chemicals advisory firm with its seat in Konin. Its REACH/CLP page lists safety data sheets, mixture classification, CLP labels, PCN notifications and UFI codes, C&L inventory notifications, help with ECHA registration and compliance audits.

entries.title: Normec Foodcare training CLP & REACH
entries.description: Normec Foodcare, part of Normec Group and based in 's-Hertogenbosch, offers a CLP & REACH training through Normec Training & Education. The course covers classifying and labelling substances and mixtures under CLP, from safety data sheet to label, and is offered in-company or by open enrolment with a certificate of participation.

entries.title: Tenviro REACH and CLP trainings
entries.description: Tenviro AB is a chemicals-legislation consultancy registered in Lessebo, Sweden, founded in 2010, that works for clients across the Netherlands. It runs in-company and online trainings on REACH and CLP, including CLP labelling and classification of mixtures, and also prepares safety data sheets in all EU languages and poison centre notifications.

entries.title: Llewellyn Europe safety data sheets
entries.description: Llewellyn (Safety Advisors) Europe Ltd in Raunds, England, writes safety data sheets for single substances and for mixtures, in many languages and with the customer's company details, and lists SDS coverage for 19 countries. The company also works as a dangerous goods safety adviser and trainer.

entries.title: Yordas Group hazard communication
entries.description: Yordas Group, with its head office at Lancaster University in the UK, is a scientific and regulatory consultancy whose hazard communication team authors, translates and updates safety data sheets, classifies products to GHS and CLP and checks label artwork. The group also acts as EU REACH Only Representative, prepares poison centre notifications and sells the Yordas Helix regulatory software.

entries.title: Formpak
entries.description: Formpak is formulation and regulatory software from Formpak Limited in Sharnbrook, England, for flavour, fragrance, ingredients, cosmetics and homecare teams. It calculates GHS hazard classes from formulation and ingredient data and generates safety data sheets and hazard labels for EU CLP, GB GHS and OSHA, with modules for UFI management, poison centre data and transport classification.

entries.title: Barkwith Associates Classification & Labelling
entries.description: Barkwith Associates Ltd in Stamford, Lincolnshire, founded in 2002, is a regulatory and technical support consultancy for plant protection products, biocides, fertilisers and chemicals. Its classification and labelling team classifies mixtures under CLP and GHS, writes and reviews safety data sheets, advises on label content and submits poison centre notifications with UFIs. REACH registration and Only Representative work sits with its sister companies Barkwith Chemical and Barkwith Europe in Dublin.

entries.title: Caroline Raine Chemical Consultancy
entries.description: Caroline Raine Chemical Consultancy is a UK regulatory consultancy covering supply and transport regulation, GB and EU CLP, UK and EU REACH and safety data sheets. It writes and translates safety data sheets, classifies products for supply and transport, makes C&L and poison centre notifications, handles UK REACH registrations and runs training courses.

entries.title: CEA Safety data sheets and CLP/GHS
entries.description: Cambridge Environmental Assessments (CEA), a research and consultancy group established within ADAS in 2001 and part of RSK Group since 2016, prepares safety data sheets to CLP/GHS in English and all official EU languages, including extended SDSs from chemical safety reports. It also classifies substances under CLP, designs product labels in Member State languages and carries out CLP notifications for clients.

entries.title: CE.way SDS
entries.description: CE.way Regulatory Consultants is a regulatory consulting and testing company for cosmetic products, with offices in Dublin, Ljubljana, London, Phoenix, Vancouver, Dubai and Istanbul. Besides EU and UK Responsible Person, safety assessment (CPSR) and CPNP/SCPN notification services, it generates multilingual EU- and UK-accepted safety data sheets and ready-to-print labels for cosmetics and chemicals with third-party software.

entries.title: Sussex Compliance GB MCL & CLP Screening
entries.description: Sussex Compliance TG Limited in Brighton, England, is a quality and compliance consultancy for chemical and advanced manufacturers whose main work is ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 audits and gap analyses. Its GB MCL & CLP screening reviews up to five formulations against the current GB mandatory classification list and EU harmonised classifications and reports, per product, the classification in each market and which documents need updating.

entries.title: Scitegrity Controlled & Regulated Chemicals
entries.description: Scitegrity Limited, founded in 2011 and based in Sandwich, Kent, UK, makes web-based software that checks chemicals by name or structure against controlled-substance and regulated-chemical lists of over 28 countries and international conventions, updated weekly. Other modules give HS tariff codes and screen chemicals for explosive or energetic properties for dangerous goods and GHS assessments.

entries.title: UmEnA safety data sheets
entries.description: UmEnA GmbH is an Austrian engineering office for technical chemistry, founded in 2007, working in chemicals law, dangerous goods and biocides. It prepares and monitors safety data sheets, classifies substances and mixtures under CLP, checks labels, handles SCIP and PCN notifications and biocide authorisation dossiers, and offers an Only Representative service.

entries.title: ACS safety data sheets and CLP labelling
entries.description: ACS Analytical Control Service GmbH is an engineering office for technical chemistry and process engineering in Ried in der Riedmark, Austria, founded in 1993. Within its chemicals law and substance assessment work it prepares safety data sheets and labelling in all EU languages under REACH and CLP and makes UFI notifications to ECHA, alongside emission measurements, explosion protection and permit engineering.

entries.title: Staphyt REACH dossiers and Only Representative
entries.description: Staphyt is a group founded in 1989 and headquartered in Inchy-en-Artois, France, that provides field, laboratory and regulatory services and has a regulatory office in Bad Vöslau, Austria. For chemicals it prepares REACH registration documents, acts as Only Representative under EU and UK REACH, and advises on classification and labelling and the creation or revision of safety data sheets.

entries.title: EcoServe chemicals law courses
entries.description: EcoServe International AG, founded in 1986 as Muff & Partner and based in Buchs AG, Switzerland, works on special waste, dangerous goods and chemicals. Its courses include "Grundlagen Chemikalienrecht" (GHS, the Swiss Chemicals Ordinance and CLP, classification and labelling, the safety data sheet) and "Sachkenntnis Chemikalien" with the exam for selling particularly hazardous chemicals, held in Buchs and, with few exceptions, in-house.

entries.title: SIU Sachkenntnis Chemikalien mit Zertifikat
entries.description: SIU, the Schweizerisches Institut für Unternehmerschulung in Zurich, Switzerland, is an adult education school. Its two-day course "Sachkenntnis Chemikalien mit Zertifikat", held in Bern, Olten and Zurich for people who supply hazardous substances in trade (groups 1 and 2), covers the legal basis, GHS labelling, safety data sheets and customer advice, and ends with an open-book exam and a Sachkenntnis certificate.

entries.title: Swiss Safety Center Gefahrstoff: Chemikalien-Ansprechperson
entries.description: The Swiss Safety Center Akademie in Wallisellen, Switzerland, run by Swiss Safety Center AG, offers the one-day course "Gefahrstoff: Chemikalien-Ansprechperson" for future or appointed chemicals contact persons and safety officers. It covers the tasks of the role, the legal basis of chemicals law, placing hazardous substances on the market, safety data sheet management and GHS basics, with a separately booked exam leading to a certificate.

entries.title: Quality-Coach.ch Swiss chemicals legislation courses
entries.description: Quality-Coach.ch is a small consultancy and training business in St-George, Switzerland, founded in 2009, working on leadership, quality management and Swiss chemicals legislation. Its chemicals courses include a one-day introduction to GHS and ADR, training for chemicals contact persons under SR 813.113.11 and the two-day Sachkenntnis course with federal exam for supplying chemicals, held in Aarau and Lausanne or in-house.

entries.title: Legichem Services
entries.description: Legichem Services is a regulatory support company in Strasbourg, France, set up by Etiquetage Légal, Infodyne and GMJ Phoenix for the chemical industry. It writes safety data sheets and translates them (36 languages), reviews supplier SDSs, prepares extended SDSs, CLP labels and poison centre declarations, and arranges laboratory analyses and SDS hosting.

entries.title: ARCHE Consulting
entries.description: ARCHE Consulting is a regulatory science consultancy with offices in Ghent and Leuven, Belgium, established in 2009 with roots in a Ghent University spin-off. It supports manufacturers and importers of chemicals with REACH registration dossiers, chemical safety reports and exposure scenarios, CLP classification and labelling, biocides, PFAS and other EU chemical regulations, and runs tailor-made training.

entries.title: essenscia REACH and CLP trainings
entries.description: essenscia, the Belgian federation of the chemical and life sciences industries in Brussels, runs open trainings on chemicals legislation. They include a two-day REACH and CLP summer school, a four-day CLP classification course for formulators given with experts from consultancies, and a basic product-policy course with modules on CLP labelling and writing safety data sheets; members and non-members pay different prices.

entries.title: CEHTRA
entries.description: CEHTRA is a chemical safety and regulatory consultancy registered in Cenon, France, part of the H2B Group, with further offices in Madrid, Hamburg, Frankfurt, Nottingham, New Delhi and Toronto. For chemicals it prepares REACH registration dossiers, acts as Only Representative, drafts extended safety data sheets and exposure scenarios, and provides toxicological risk assessment, regulatory watch and training.

entries.title: FECHIM Services FDS et étiquetage training
entries.description: FECHIM Services is the training company attached to UFCC, the French federation of chemical distributors, in Puteaux. Its 14-hour 'FDS et étiquetage' course covers safety data sheets under Regulation 2020/878 section by section, recent CLP labelling changes and the transport rules linked to SDS section 14; it also runs ADR, customs and other courses for the chemical distribution sector.

entries.title: CNFCE SDS, GHS/CLP and REACH training
entries.description: CNFCE is a Paris-based continuing-education company that runs inter-company, in-company and virtual-classroom courses. Its chemical-safety courses include a two-day course on writing safety data sheets under REACH and CLP, held in cities across France and online, alongside courses on designing an SDS, GHS/CLP classification and labelling, and REACH.

entries.title: Redebel Regulatory Affairs (RRA)
entries.description: Redebel Regulatory Affairs (RRA) is the regulatory affairs company of the Redebel group in Saint-Amand (Fleurus), Belgium, set up in 2016. It prepares and submits REACH registration dossiers in IUCLID, biocidal product authorisation dossiers and plant protection product registrations, handles poison centre notifications in UFI format for biocides, and runs RRA Academy training, including an online course on CLP basics.

entries.title: VUOS REACH & CLP
entries.description: VUOS a.s. (Výzkumný ústav organických syntéz) is a Czech chemical production, research and analytical company in Rybitví. Its REACH & CLP service prepares REACH registration dossiers in IUCLID 6, chemical safety reports, extended safety data sheets under REACH Annex II and revisions of existing ones, CLP classification of substances and mixtures and C&L notifications, and runs testing under the REACH annexes.

entries.title: LACHEPRA
entries.description: LACHEPRA s.r.o. is a chemical-legislation consultancy in Pardubice, Czech Republic, specialising in REACH, CLP, detergents and biocides. It identifies clients' obligations under EU, Czech and Slovak chemical law, prepares safety data sheets and other documents, deals with authorities such as the Czech Ministry of Health and ECHA, and runs seminars and webinars.

entries.title: ZCHFP SR Poradenstvo REACH a CLP
entries.description: ZCHFP SR (Zväz chemického a farmaceutického priemyslu Slovenskej republiky) is the Slovak chemical and pharmaceutical industry association in Bratislava. Its REACH and CLP advisory centre, set up in 2006, advises manufacturers, importers, distributors and professional users on REACH registration dossiers, prepares extended safety data sheets with exposure scenarios, acts as Only Representative for non-EU manufacturers, advises on CLP classification and labelling, and runs training.

entries.title: EKO-ADR KBÚ - Chemické poradenstvo
entries.description: EKO-ADR, s.r.o. is a Bratislava consultancy, with an office in Prague, that has worked in Slovakia and the Czech Republic since 2003. It prepares and revises safety data sheets for Slovakia, the Czech Republic and the EU in Slovak, Czech, English and German, handles CLP classification and labelling, poison centre notifications with UFI codes, detergent and biocide obligations, and also works as an ADR dangerous-goods safety adviser.

entries.title: Kemiaibiztonsag.hu biztonsági adatlap készítés
entries.description: Kemiaibiztonsag.hu is the chemical-safety service of GENERISK Mérnökiroda Kft., an engineering consultancy in Érd, Hungary, founded in 2005. It prepares safety data sheets for hazardous substances, mixtures, intermediates and wastes, translates, localises and reviews SDSs, trains staff and EHS specialists and carries out compliance audits, and also prepares emergency plans and biocidal product authorisations.

entries.title: Strokovnjak za kemikalije (e-izobraževanje)
entries.description: Forum Media, a Maribor-based training and professional publishing company in the Forum Media Group, sells the e-learning course "Strokovnjak za kemikalije" for people responsible for chemicals at work. The recorded course covers REACH and CLP, classification and labelling, H and P statements and pictograms, safety data sheets, PCN, UFI and SCIP, and ends with a certificate in Slovenian and English.

entries.title: Seminar kemikalije i kemijski proizvodi
entries.description: ZIRS učilište is the adult-education institution of Zavod za istraživanje i razvoj sigurnosti d.o.o. in Zagreb, Croatia. Its seminar "Kemikalije i kemijski proizvodi", for legal and natural persons in contact with hazardous chemicals, covers the Croatian Chemicals Act, obligations under REACH and CLP, the safety data sheet, labels and work instructions; it is held at ZIRS in Zagreb on agreed dates and ends with a certificate of attendance.

entries.title: HZJZ radionice za izradu STL-ova i PCN podnesaka
entries.description: The toxicology service (Služba za toksikologiju) of the Croatian Institute of Public Health (HZJZ) in Zagreb runs paid workshops in small groups on filling in safety data sheets under REACH and on preparing and submitting poison centre notifications under Annex VIII of CLP. It also runs an online course for persons responsible for work with hazardous chemicals.

entries.title: Kiwa Sverige SDS authoring and translation
entries.description: Kiwa Sweden AB, the Swedish company of the Kiwa group, prepares, translates and quality-checks safety data sheets and labels and carries out classification and labelling of chemicals under Nordic and EU rules. Its technical consulting unit also handles product notifications to the Swedish, Norwegian, Danish and Finnish product registers, C&L notifications to ECHA and REACH advice including substance registration.

entries.title: Kiwa Norge SDS authoring and translation
entries.description: Kiwa AS (Kiwa Norge), the Norwegian company of the Kiwa group in Oslo, prepares, updates and translates safety data sheets to Norwegian and EU rules, quality-checks SDSs and labels and calculates the classification and labelling of chemicals. It also handles product declarations to the Norwegian Product Register, offers a digital chemical register (Kiwa Impact) with a service agreement under which SDSs older than two years are traced each year, and runs chemical-handling courses.

entries.title: Bureau Veritas Denmark chemical documentation and SDS
entries.description: Bureau Veritas Solutions Denmark A/S, the Danish chemicals, dangerous goods and safety consulting company of Bureau Veritas (formerly Bureau Veritas HSE), prepares, updates and quality-checks safety data sheets in more than 20 languages and advises on exposure scenarios. From Fredericia, Copenhagen and Esbjerg it also handles CLP/GHS and transport classification, REACH registration and Only Representative services, and PCN notifications with UFI codes, and supplies its own chemical management software CHESS and DGDoc.

entries.title: Ramboll product safety and stewardship
entries.description: The product safety and stewardship practice of Ramboll Group A/S, a foundation-owned consultancy founded in Denmark in 1945, helps businesses manage and communicate the health and environmental impacts of chemical-related products. For the chemicals sector it covers substance evaluation, hazard and exposure assessments, data generation and registration dossiers (including TSCA and REACH-like regimes), Only Representative services, dangerous goods transport and safety data sheet and label authoring; it also works on agrochemicals, biocides, food, pharmaceuticals and cosmetics.

entries.title: Cobuilder Collaborate Safety Data Sheet Register
entries.description: A digital safety data sheet register inside Cobuilder Collaborate, the construction product-data platform of Cobuilder AS (registered office Lysaker, Norway; headquartered in Oslo with an office in Sofia). Contractors keep SDSs and exposure data linked to supplier product data in a searchable, version-controlled register shared via web and app, which flags products missing an SDS and substances of concern and tracks approvals.

entries.title: Notisum Kemiservice
entries.description: Kemiservice is the chemicals module of Notisum AB, a Malmö-based provider of web-based EHS legal registers for companies in Sweden, Denmark, Norway and Finland. It gathers a company's safety data sheets in one place and helps create chemical risk assessments and instructions for employees; the Danish version adds a chemicals overview using CLP signal words and screening of chemicals against the Danish Working Environment Authority's substance lists.

entries.title: Kompetences centrs
entries.description: Kompetences centrs is a Riga-based consultancy that helps companies manufacturing, importing or distributing chemical products, cosmetics and other goods meet regulatory requirements. Its services include registrations, labels, product documentation, compliance audits and staff training.

entries.title: Kimyasal Danışmanı
entries.description: Kimyasal Danışmanı is the chemical-regulatory consultancy of Bilgi Çevre Mühendislik, a firm in Tuzla, Istanbul, that started work in 2010. It prepares and updates safety data sheets, handles KKDİK (Turkish REACH) pre-registration, registration and Only Representative work, and SEA (CLP) classification and labelling, alongside BEKRA, dangerous-goods and environmental consulting.

entries.title: MSDS Dükkan
entries.description: MSDS Dükkan is the safety data sheet service of Bitek Mühendislik Müşavirlik Danışmanlık in Etimesgut, Ankara. It prepares Turkish-language safety data sheets (GBF/MSDS) by certified preparers and handles product notifications for cosmetics, detergents, strong acids and bases, air fresheners and medical devices.

entries.title: ONAY Mühendislik
entries.description: ONAY Mühendislik is an Istanbul (Kartal) chemical-regulatory consultancy, operated by ONAYMUH DANIŞMANLIK A.Ş., working since 2010. It handles KKDİK (Turkish REACH) registration, Only Representative and MBDF consortium work, EU and UK REACH registration support, Turkish safety data sheets prepared by a certified chemical assessment expert (KDU), SEA (CLP) classification and labelling, UFI/PCN notifications and in-company training.

entries.title: KKDIK.AI
entries.description: KKDIK.AI is a Turkish-language chemical-regulation information platform run by the Istanbul consultancy ONAY Mühendislik. It holds a database of 6,212 substances from the KKDİK reference substance list, searchable by CAS or EC number with hazard classes and H codes, and 14 browser-based calculators for KKDİK, SEA, SDS and UFI questions such as ATEmix, aquatic M-factor and a 16-section SDS check.

entries.title: EnviProAdvice
entries.description: EnviProAdvice is a Sofia-based environmental and chemicals consultancy. Its chemical management services include preparing, validating and updating safety data sheets in Bulgarian, English, Russian and German, REACH registration dossiers and representation, CLP classification and notifications, poison-centre notifications, biocide dossiers and training on REACH and CLP.

entries.title: A.E.J. Consulting SDS translation and authoring
entries.description: A.E.J. Consulting is a business consultancy in Jelgava, Latvia, founded in 2004. Alongside EU structural-fund project work it translates safety data sheets from English and Russian into Latvian, prepares SDSs, reviews them against REACH, reclassifies substances and products under CLP and prepares labels.

entries.title: Sistem Çevre KDU consulting
entries.description: Sistem Çevre is an environmental consultancy founded in Izmir in 1999. Its chemical assessment expert (KDU) consulting covers KKDİK (Turkish REACH) registration and consortium work, SEA (CLP) classification, preparation and revision of 16-section safety data sheets in Turkish and English, chemical safety reports and exposure scenarios.

entries.title: SDSWriter SDS authoring
entries.description: SDSWriter (MSDS Writer, LLC) in Skokie, Illinois, authors safety data sheets or converts them to national and international standards, updates and translates them, and prepares compliant container labels. It also runs outsourced SDS operations for clients' compliance departments and offers HazCom training and California SB 258 compliance support.

entries.title: Valence Regulatory SDS authoring
entries.description: Valence Regulatory LLC, based in Wilmington, Delaware, authors safety data sheets and classifies chemical mixtures for the US (OSHA HCS), the EU (REACH and CLP), Canada (WHMIS) and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil), including transport classification.
